subject: FB-1: Install FeatureBench + arm64 Docker smoke test
description: Stand up FeatureBench locally and retire the arm64 Docker risk. Steps: (1) create a py3.10/3.11 venv (3.13 may lack wheels), `pip install featurebench`; (2) copy config_example.toml → config.toml; (3) `fb pull --mode fast` to pre-pull the 100-instance fast-split images; (4) run `fb eval` on GOLD patches for a handful of instances to confirm the Docker test-eval pipeline builds and scores on Apple Silicon (arm64). If images are amd64-only, document the emulation (`--platform linux/amd64`) result or the cloud-x86 fallback. Success: at least one fast-split instance evaluates green from gold patch on this Mac. Repo: https://github.com/LiberCoders/FeatureBench
